requirements.contract: PostgresCalendarEventStore must implement ICalendarEventStore (Get/Add/Save) on the approved calendar schema with atomic optimistic concurrency (Save with expectedVersion, CalendarEventConcurrencyException, KeyNotFoundException), tenant boundary and attendee order preservation. The unified schedule read model must return active tasks and calendar events intersecting the window [fromUtc, toUtc) with exact all-day/timing semantics, optional users/projects/status filters, deterministic sorting, and overlap conflicts with the 30-minute severity threshold. Schema 003, Task.Domain and public application contracts were already approved and must not change.
requirements.rules: Implementation follows the approved foundation conventions: NpgsqlDataSource, raw SQL with $N typed parameters, single transactions for writes, no ORM, no new dependencies, string enums matching schema CHECK values, store pre-filtering coarse and service filtering exact.
